title.narrative: Trust Fund for Sustaining Peace in Colombia

description.narrative: The United Nations Multi-Partner Trust Fund for Sustaining Peace in Colombia finances coordinated responses that guarantee stabilization through the design and implementation of people and peace-centered agreements, frameworks, and programmes.
